Privacy in plain words

Private by default.

Pairlum is a private space for two people. Here is what that means in practice. The full policies are in the list, and they’re what count.

  • [01]
    Adults only.

    Pairlum is for people aged 18 or older. Creating an account confirms you are. Privacy §2

  • [02]
    Just the two of you.

    One space holds two accounts. There are no public couple profiles, follower lists, public feeds or like counts. Privacy §16

  • [03]
    Your memories are yours.

    You keep ownership of what you add. Pairlum uses it only to run the service for you. Privacy §12

  • [04]
    Never sold.

    Pairlum doesn’t sell your private content or intimate relationship information, and doesn’t build advertising profiles from it. Privacy §14

  • [05]
    Not an AI training set.

    Your private photos, voice, letters and memories aren’t a general AI-training dataset. Any broader use would need your separate permission. And Pairlum never uses AI to write messages pretending to be your partner. Privacy §13

  • [06]
    Take it with you.

    You can export your data. Exports are delivered securely, never as an unprotected email attachment. Export §4

  • [07]
    Deleting is clear.

    Deleting one memory, leaving your space, deleting your account and deleting your shared space are four separate actions with different results. A deleted memory can be restored for 30 days. Deletion §2

These policies are drafts, not yet in effect. They are awaiting review by qualified Indian counsel before launch.

Privacy Policy

Operator: [LEGAL NAME / ENTITY OPERATING PAIRLUM], [LEGAL / BUSINESS ADDRESS], India. Replace all contact placeholders and planned domain emails before publication.

§1. Scope and privacy principle

Pairlum is a private relationship space. This Privacy Policy applies to pairlum.com, Pairlum accounts and Couple Spaces, Memories, Letters, Chapters, Time Capsules, Parallel Moments, reactions, Pairlum Book, free public tools, payments, support and other Pairlum services that link to it.

Pairlum is designed around four permanent principles: private relationship content is private by default; users retain ownership of what they create; private memories are not sold as an advertising product; and private relationship content is not used to train AI models by default.

§2. Adults only

Pairlum V1 is intended only for people aged 18 years or older. By creating an account, a user confirms that they are at least 18. Pairlum may restrict or delete an ineligible minor account when identified, subject to applicable law.

§3. Account and Couple Space information

  • Name, email address, authentication/account identifiers, account settings and security/session information.
  • Partner invitation information, Couple Space identifiers, optional relationship start/anniversary dates, milestones, covers and other information deliberately added by the Couple.
  • Pairlum should not require unnecessary sensitive information simply for personalization.

§4. Private Content

“Private Content” includes photographs, videos, voice recordings, notes, captions, Memories, Letters, Open When/Locked Letters, Time Capsules, Chapters, Parallel Moments, reactions, Book selections/layouts and other content intentionally added to a Couple Space.

Private Content is not public by default. A connected partner may access content according to the rules of the relevant feature. Joining Pairlum does not grant Pairlum marketing rights over that content.

§5. Information your partner may provide

A connected partner may invite you, upload a photograph containing you, create a shared Memory, write a Letter, add a milestone, react, or contribute to a shared object. Pairlum must distinguish partner sharing from public disclosure and should provide appropriate product controls.

§6. Technical, usage and analytics information

  • Browser/device/OS, IP and network/security information, session identifiers, application version, referrer/campaign data, performance/error information and feature events.
  • Analytics should measure behaviour around private content rather than the substance of the content. Example: `memory_created=true`, not the photograph or Letter body.
  • Private session replay is disabled in authenticated Couple Spaces for V1.

§7. Photo and media metadata

Original media may contain capture date, device details and location metadata. Pairlum may use limited metadata to organize a Memory, strip unnecessary metadata from viewing derivatives, and preserve the private original where required for archival/Book quality. Visible location should remain user-controlled where practical.

§8. Payments

An external payment provider processes payment credentials. Pairlum may retain order/payment IDs, amount, currency, status, date, cohort, refund status and limited payment-method information. Pairlum does not intend to store full card numbers, CVV, UPI PINs or banking passwords.

§9. Pairlum Book information

  • Eligibility date, selected Memories, selected media, Book layout, cover, proof/approval status and print-quality status.
  • Recipient name, shipping address, telephone number where courier-required, order/production/tracking status.
  • Shipping information should be collected when fulfilment is actually needed, not unnecessarily at account creation.

§10. Support and feedback

Pairlum may process contact details, tickets, feedback, screenshots voluntarily supplied, and technical details relevant to a support issue. Founding feedback does not transfer ownership of private memories.

§11. Purposes of processing

  • Provide and secure accounts and Couple Spaces; operate Memories, Letters, Chapters, Capsules and other features.
  • Preserve originals, generate derivatives, authorize partner access and operate Book creation/fulfilment.
  • Process memberships, payments/refunds, support, service communications and legally required records.
  • Monitor reliability, product funnels, abuse, security and performance using privacy-minimized analytics.
  • Comply with valid legal obligations and protect users/Pairlum.

§12. Ownership and limited operational licence

Users retain ownership of the content they lawfully create or upload. Pairlum receives only the limited, non-exclusive permission reasonably necessary to host, store, back up, transcode, generate previews, display to authorized users, transmit, create an approved Book and otherwise provide requested features.

The licence is not a general right to sell private content or use it in advertising.

§13. AI and private memories

Pairlum may later offer optional AI-assisted organization, Book curation, duplicate detection, question generation or similar features. Private photographs, video, voice, Letters, Notes and Time Capsules are not a general AI-training dataset by default.

If a requested AI feature requires private content to be processed by an AI service, the relevant processing should be explained. Any broader AI training using private relationship content requires a separate appropriate permission process.

§14. No sale of intimate relationship data

Pairlum does not sell Private Content or intimate relationship information to advertisers and should not build advertising profiles based on inferred relationship quality, conflicts, private Letters, photos or emotional vulnerability.

§15. When information may be shared

  • With the connected partner according to feature permissions.
  • With service providers for authentication, cloud infrastructure/storage, media processing, payments, email, analytics/error monitoring, Book printing and logistics, limited to what the provider needs.
  • For valid legal/safety/security reasons where disclosure or preservation is required or permitted.
  • As part of a legitimate business reorganization subject to applicable safeguards.
  • With separate user permission for testimonials, public stories or marketing.

§16. Public profiles

Pairlum V1 does not normally provide public Couple profiles, follower lists, public Memory feeds, publicly searchable couples or public relationship scores.

§17. Security safeguards

  • Authenticated access, server-side authorization, private media storage, short-lived signed media access, encryption in transit and at rest where supported.
  • Database access controls/RLS, administrator MFA, least privilege, audit logging, backups and restricted production access.
  • Pairlum does not claim “100% security” and does not claim end-to-end encryption unless it is actually implemented.

§18. Administrative access

Ordinary administration should not require casual access to Private Content. Admin tools should expose account, membership, storage, payment, Book and error metadata. Exceptional private-content access must have a legitimate purpose, minimum scope and audit trail as defined in D9.

§19. Retention and deletion

Pairlum retains information only as long as reasonably necessary for the relevant purpose or legal obligation. Eligible ordinary deleted content is intended to remain in Recently Deleted for 30 days, after which permanent deletion from active systems begins.

Protected backups may retain deleted information temporarily until the backup lifecycle expires. Payment, accounting, fraud/security and legal records may require longer retention. Specific production retention periods must be finalized before publication.

§20. Account vs Couple Space

An individual account and the shared Couple Space are separate. One partner deleting an individual account should not automatically and silently erase everything belonging to the other partner. Shared-content deletion must account for who contributed the content, applicable rights, legal obligations and the design of the relevant shared object.

§21. Separation

Pairlum should permit users to leave a Couple Space, export eligible data, delete eligible content or delete an account without manipulative breakup/guilt mechanics. Founding status does not obligate a couple to remain together.

§22. User choices and rights

  • Access information about personal data processed about them, subject to applicable law.
  • Correct inaccurate/incomplete information.
  • Delete eligible content or request account deletion.
  • Withdraw consent where consent is the applicable basis.
  • Use Pairlum’s product export functionality for eligible data, subject to the rights of the other partner.
  • Raise a privacy grievance and use applicable statutory remedies.
  • Use nomination rights where and when applicable under Indian data-protection law.

§23. Cookies and tracking

Pairlum may use essential authentication/security/session technologies, analytics, and later optional marketing technologies. Marketing tracking is not to be disguised as essential. D6 gives the detailed notice.

§24. Free public tools

Couple Questions, Date Ideas and Love Messages may process the inputs required to generate the requested result. Pairlum should avoid unnecessarily retaining intimate free-tool inputs. Saved results may become account data when the user deliberately saves them.

§25. Communications

Pairlum may send verification, partner invitation, security, password reset, payment, Letter/Capsule, Book and other service communications. Marketing messages should have an appropriate opt-out mechanism; opting out of marketing does not disable necessary security/transactional messages.

§26. Security incidents

Pairlum will maintain an incident process to investigate, contain, assess, document, notify where legally required, and remediate personal-data breaches.

§27. Policy changes and contact

Material changes may be notified by email, account notice or website notice, and fresh consent should be obtained where legally required. Privacy requests: [PRIVACY EMAIL]; support: [SUPPORT EMAIL]; legal: [LEGAL EMAIL]; grievance contact: [NAME / DESIGNATION / ADDRESS].

§1. Agreement and eligibility

These Terms govern access to Pairlum, including the website, Couple Spaces, Memories, Letters, Chapters, Time Capsules, Parallel Moments, Pairlum Book, free tools and related services. By creating an account, joining a Couple Space, purchasing a membership or otherwise using Pairlum, the user agrees to these Terms.

Pairlum V1 is for users aged 18+ who have legal capacity to contract and provide reasonably accurate account information.

§2. What Pairlum is — and is not

Pairlum is a private relationship space that helps two people build, experience and preserve their relationship. It is not a public social network, dating service, therapist, mental-health provider, legal adviser or emergency service; it does not guarantee relationship outcomes.

§3. Individual accounts and security

Each person should maintain their own account and credentials. Users must secure login information and report suspected compromise. Pairlum may require reauthentication for high-risk actions such as credential changes, exports, partner removal and deletion.

§4. Couple Spaces

A Couple Space is the shared environment for two connected eligible users. It is separate from each individual account. Different controls may apply to individually created, partner-created and jointly created content.

§5. Partner invitations

Invitations may expire, be revoked, be recipient-limited and become invalid after acceptance. Fraudulent or abusive invitations are prohibited.

§6. Membership unit

Unless Pairlum expressly states otherwise, one eligible Couple Space is the billing unit; the connected partner does not separately pay for the same membership.

§7. Content ownership and rights

Users retain ownership of lawful content they create/upload. They grant Pairlum the limited operational licence necessary to store, process, display, transmit, back up and produce approved Books. Users represent that they have the rights/permissions needed to upload and, where requested, print the content.

§8. Partner access and privacy

Content may be visible to the connected partner according to feature rules. Locked Letters and Time Capsules remain unavailable until server-validated unlock conditions. Pairlum V1 is private by default and does not provide public follower/like/relationship-score mechanics.

§9. Marketing and AI

Account creation is not marketing consent. Pairlum must obtain separate permission for testimonials, photos, stories and public Book reactions where required. Private Content is not used to train AI models by default; optional AI-assisted features are separately disclosed as appropriate.

§10. Prohibited use

  • Illegal activity, fraud, harassment, impersonation, non-consensual intimate content, child exploitation, malware or unauthorized security access.
  • Accessing another Couple Space, scraping private data, abuse of payment/promotional logic, or reselling non-transferable entitlements.
  • Uploading content without required rights or using Pairlum to violate another person’s privacy/IP rights.

§11. Suspension and termination

Pairlum may proportionately restrict, suspend or terminate accounts for fraud, serious security risk, illegal activity, material Terms violations or other legitimate legal/operational reasons. Inactivity alone does not justify revoking confirmed Founding status.

§12. Founding 50

The Founding 50 program is additionally governed by D4. Founding status is limited, non-transferable and not automatically a promise that every future product or physical item will be free. The qualifying membership is ₹0 while the applicable service continues, subject to the applicable Terms.

§13. Paid membership and V1 renewal

Before payment Pairlum displays the price, term, tax treatment where applicable, major benefits and renewal status. V1 annual memberships do not auto-renew unless recurring billing is later introduced with affirmative consent. Promotional first-year pricing does not guarantee the same renewal price unless expressly stated.

§14. Payments and refunds

Paid entitlement activates only after authoritative payment confirmation. Failed/pending/unverified payments do not activate membership. Pairlum does not intend to store full card/CVV/UPI PIN/banking passwords. Refunds/cancellations are governed by D3.

§15. Pairlum Book

Book benefits are governed by D5. Eligibility does not mean automatic printing; Book creation may require selection, quality checks, proof review, final approval, shipping details and production. Pairlum will not impose undisclosed engagement/streak requirements after purchase.

§16. Separation, leaving and deletion

Pairlum recognizes that relationships can change or end. Users may use available leave/export/delete tools. One partner cannot automatically erase the entire other partner’s account/archive. The detailed process is governed by D8.

§17. Recently Deleted and export

Eligible content may enter a 30-day Recently Deleted period before permanent active-system deletion. Pairlum aims to provide useful exports of eligible data and should not intentionally hold eligible memories hostage solely to force payment.

§18. Free tools

Free Couple Questions, Date Ideas, Love Messages and other suggestions are general-purpose and may not suit every situation. Users remain responsible for deciding whether/how to use them.

§19. Availability and product evolution

Pairlum may maintain, upgrade, redesign, add, replace or discontinue features. It does not guarantee 100% uptime or that every prototype/roadmap concept will be built. Material specifically purchased/earned benefits remain subject to applicable contract and consumer-law protections.

§20. Storage and fair use

Pairlum may impose reasonable technical/fair-use limits to operate sustainably and securely, but must disclose material customer-facing limits. “Unlimited storage” should not be promised unless truly supported. Users should retain their own copies of especially irreplaceable originals where practical.

§21. Pairlum intellectual property

Pairlum retains rights in its name, logo, software, interface, original designs, Book templates and proprietary materials. Users receive a limited personal, non-transferable right to use the service and may not resell access, copy protected software or falsely represent affiliation.

§22. Third parties and feedback

Pairlum relies on third-party infrastructure, payment, email, analytics, printing and shipping providers. General product feedback may be used to improve Pairlum but does not transfer ownership of the user’s Private Content.

§23. Security

Users must not exploit vulnerabilities, bypass security, access other users’ data or distribute credentials. Legitimate vulnerabilities should be responsibly reported to [SECURITY EMAIL].

§24. Disclaimers and liability

To the extent permitted by law, Pairlum is provided on an “as available” basis and cannot guarantee every feature, upload or third-party service will always work. Mandatory consumer rights and liabilities that cannot lawfully be excluded remain unaffected.

Counsel review required: any contractual liability cap, exclusions, indemnities and remedies must be finalized for the actual legal entity and product risk profile before publication.

§25. Service discontinuation

If Pairlum permanently discontinues a paid service during an active prepaid term, it will provide an appropriate remedy under the Refund Policy and applicable law. Where reasonably possible, Pairlum should provide advance notice and export opportunity before permanently closing an archive service.

§26. Changes, electronic acceptance and versioning

Pairlum may update Terms for product/legal/security changes. Material changes may receive additional notice; fresh consent is sought where legally required. Pairlum may record Terms version, user/Couple identifier and acceptance timestamp.

§27. Governing law, disputes and grievance

The Terms are governed by Indian law without removing mandatory consumer rights. Users should first contact support; formal legal matters go to [LEGAL EMAIL]. Final jurisdiction/court language must be completed as [CITY / STATE AFTER COUNSEL REVIEW] and must not improperly remove statutory forums available to consumers.

D3 · Public policy

Cancellation & Refund Policy

Draft, not yet in effect. This policy is awaiting review by qualified Indian counsel. Bracketed items such as [LEGAL NAME / ENTITY] are intentional until they are formally confirmed.

PUBLICATION DRAFT | Last updated: 26 August 2026 | Target effective date: 4 September 2026

Operator: [LEGAL NAME / ENTITY OPERATING PAIRLUM], [LEGAL / BUSINESS ADDRESS], India. Replace all contact placeholders and planned domain emails before publication.

§1. Membership structure

  • Founding 50: qualifying membership price ₹0.
  • Early 100: ₹999 for the first year.
  • Standard annual: ₹5,999 per year.
  • The exact checkout terms control. One eligible membership covers one Couple Space unless stated otherwise.

§2. No hidden V1 auto-renewal

V1 annual memberships do not automatically renew. Pairlum may send renewal reminders, but a new payment is required unless recurring billing is later introduced and affirmatively accepted.

§3. Voluntary 7-day full-refund window

Pairlum provides a voluntary 7-calendar-day full-refund window from successful payment for eligible paid memberships. The user need not provide a lengthy justification. Pairlum may request only enough information to locate and verify the payment.

If fully refunded, the paid membership entitlement and future benefits tied to completion of that membership (including an unearned included Book) normally end.

§4. After 7 days

After the voluntary period, payments are generally not refundable merely because the user changed their mind, stopped using Pairlum, did not use every feature, or the relationship changed/ended. This does not remove remedies required by applicable consumer law or discretionary remedies Pairlum reasonably grants.

§5. Service failure and discontinuation

Appropriate refund, extension or other remedy may apply where Pairlum fails to activate a verified payment, materially fails to provide the purchased service, delivers a service materially different from what was represented, or permanently discontinues a prepaid service. Pro-rata remedies may be appropriate depending on the circumstances and applicable law.

§6. Duplicate, failed and pending payments

Unintended duplicate payments should normally be refunded after verification. Pending/failed payments do not activate membership until authoritative success. If funds are debited but the transaction fails, Pairlum will provide relevant transaction references and assist as reasonably possible.

§7. Unauthorized payments and disputes

Users should contact Pairlum and their bank/payment provider promptly. Pairlum may place the related membership under review while investigating. This policy does not remove chargeback or statutory rights.

§8. Refund method and amount

Refunds are returned to the original payment method where technically possible. Pairlum will not ask for CVV, OTP, UPI PIN or banking password. A full eligible refund returns the eligible amount actually paid; ordinary gateway fees are not deducted from the customer’s approved full refund.

§9. Timing

After Pairlum initiates a refund, the bank/payment network controls final posting time. Pairlum should communicate the provider’s current expected range and provide a refund/ARN/RRN/UTR reference where available rather than guarantee an impossible fixed bank timeline.

§10. Refund is not deletion

A refund/cancellation is not an account-deletion request and must not silently erase the Couple archive. Account/data actions follow D8.

§11. Founding 50 and Early 100

Founding membership is ₹0, so there is no membership payment to refund. If an Early 100 qualifying payment is fully refunded, that paid promotional entitlement normally ceases and the place may return to availability according to Pairlum’s cohort logic. The ₹999 first-year price does not promise a ₹999 renewal price unless explicitly stated.

§12. Pairlum Book and refunds

If a qualifying paid membership is fully refunded before completing the one-year Book eligibility period, the future included Book entitlement normally ends. Separate/custom Book purchases are governed by D5 and specific checkout terms.

§13. Customized Book cancellation

Ordinary change-of-mind cancellation may stop being available after the final personalized Book proof is approved and manufacturing begins. This does not remove remedies for defective, damaged, wrong or materially non-conforming Books.

§14. Promotions, taxes and chargebacks

Refunds ordinarily use the amount actually paid after valid discounts. Taxes are handled according to applicable invoicing/tax law. Formal chargebacks may cause the associated membership to be marked under review while the dispute is resolved.

§15. How to request

Request through account controls where available or [SUPPORT EMAIL]. Provide the account email, Couple ID if known, order/payment reference, date and amount. Pairlum should record REQUESTED → REVIEWING → APPROVED/DECLINED → INITIATED → PROCESSED states and explain a declined request.

§16. Refund principle

Clear price before payment; no hidden automatic renewal; seven days to change your mind on an eligible membership; fair remedies when Pairlum genuinely fails; no unnecessary cancellation charge; and billing actions never silently destroy memories.

D4 · Public policy

Founding 50 Terms

PUBLICATION DRAFT — LIMITED COHORT | Last updated: 26 August 2026 | Target effective date: 4 September 2026

Operator: [LEGAL NAME / ENTITY OPERATING PAIRLUM], [LEGAL / BUSINESS ADDRESS], India. Replace all contact placeholders and planned domain emails before publication.

§1. Program

Pairlum begins with 50 Founding Couples who are among the first relationships to use the product and may voluntarily help shape it through real usage and feedback. Founding 50 is an early-user program, not a relationship contest or ranking.

§2. Eligibility

  • Both partners are 18+ and each uses their own eligible account.
  • Both join the same Couple Space and accept the applicable Pairlum Terms and Founding Terms.
  • The activation process is completed while a Founding place remains available.
  • Pairlum may review fraud, duplicate claims, bots, fake accounts, abuse or attempted resale. Pairlum does not normally judge the legitimacy/quality of a relationship.

§3. Activation and 48-hour reservation

An application alone does not permanently consume one of the 50 positions. Intended flow: Application → Eligible → Reserved → Account → Partner Invite → Partner Joins → Both Accept → Active Founding.

A standard reservation lasts approximately 48 hours. If activation is not completed, the reservation may expire and the position may return to availability.

§4. Founding number

Activated Couple Spaces may receive Founding #001–#050 according to activation sequence. The number is provenance, not relationship quality, importance, activity or popularity.

§5. Membership price and duration

The qualifying Founding membership price is ₹0 for the eligible Couple Space. The benefit applies without a recurring membership fee for as long as the applicable Pairlum service continues to be made available, subject to the Founding Terms and general Terms.

This is not a legal promise that Pairlum must exist forever or that every future physical/unrelated product will always be free.

§6. Included membership scope

Founding membership includes the applicable Pairlum membership/core features Pairlum makes available. Pairlum may improve, redesign, add, replace or discontinue individual features; Founding status does not freeze the September 2026 product forever.

§7. What is not automatically free

  • Additional Books or special editions, merchandise, unsupported/premium international delivery, expedited shipping, unrelated third-party services, separately priced future experiences or additional Couple Spaces.
  • Pairlum may voluntarily add Founding benefits later without making every future benefit permanent.

§8. Included Pairlum Book

Each eligible Founding Couple receives one included Pairlum Book after completing one full qualifying year, subject to D5. Eligibility is generally activation date + one completed year.

There is no hidden requirement for daily use, a streak, 365 Memories, relationship score or minimum Letter/reaction count.

§9. Book process and territory

Eligibility does not mean automatic printing. The Couple may need to curate, review quality, approve the proof, provide shipping information and complete production steps. Standard initial included fulfilment is intended for India; unsupported international delivery may be unavailable or separately charged. The Book has no automatic cash-substitute value unless required/offered.

§10. Feedback

Founding Couples are invited to provide bugs, criticism, product suggestions and emotional wins, but are not required to submit a fixed number of reviews, post publicly, promote Pairlum or provide positive feedback to keep confirmed Founding status.

§11. Marketing is optional

Testimonials, Founding Wall recognition, photos, Book reaction videos and public stories require separate appropriate permission. Founding membership is not marketing consent.

§12. Non-transferability and partner replacement

Founding status belongs to the original qualifying Couple Space and may not normally be sold, transferred, gifted or assigned. Partner replacement is not automatic and may require manual review; Founding status does not automatically transfer into every future relationship.

§13. Separation and inactivity

A relationship may change/end. Pairlum does not require a Couple to remain together or explain a breakup. Ordinary inactivity, absence of streaks or refusal to promote Pairlum does not automatically revoke confirmed Founding status.

§14. Revocation

Pairlum may revoke Founding status for fraud, fake/automated registration, deliberate duplicate claims, resale, serious infrastructure abuse, illegal activity, security violations, unauthorized cross-couple access or other serious material breach. Criticism, inactivity, refusing marketing or ending the relationship are not valid revocation reasons.

§15. Review and effect of revocation

Where reasonably appropriate Pairlum should review the suspected issue, record the reason, give notice/opportunity to clarify, and audit the decision. Immediate restriction may be appropriate for fraud/security/unlawful risk. Valid revocation may end the ₹0 entitlement and an unearned Book benefit, but does not transfer ownership of user content to Pairlum.

§16. Limit and waitlist

Only 50 confirmed activated Founding Couple Spaces receive Founding 50 status unless Pairlum creates a distinct future program. Once #050 activates, the program closes. Waitlist status or prior application does not guarantee a place.

§17. Electronic acceptance

Both partners should affirmatively accept the Founding Terms; Pairlum records user IDs, Couple ID, Terms version, acceptance timestamp, activation timestamp and Founding number. Do not use pre-ticked acceptance.

Pairlum Book Terms

Draft, not yet in effect. This policy is awaiting review by qualified Indian counsel. Bracketed items such as [LEGAL NAME / ENTITY] are intentional until they are formally confirmed.

PUBLICATION DRAFT — PHYSICAL PRODUCT | Last updated: 26 August 2026 | Target effective date: 4 September 2026

Operator: [LEGAL NAME / ENTITY OPERATING PAIRLUM], [LEGAL / BUSINESS ADDRESS], India. Replace all contact placeholders and planned domain emails before publication.

§1. The Pairlum Book

The Pairlum Book is a personalized physical relationship archive created from content selected from an eligible Couple Space. It is a curated keepsake, not a promise to reproduce every item stored in Pairlum.

§2. Intended V1 standard specification

  • Approximately 9 × 9 inch square format.
  • Approximately 40 pages / 20 spreads.
  • Premium lay-flat or equivalent premium binding.
  • Cloth/linen-style hardcover, full-colour premium interior and editorial archival design.
  • Pairlum presentation packaging where available.
  • The final specification shown before approval controls; reasonable equivalent material/vendor changes may occur when supply/quality requires.

§3. Who receives an included Book

An included Book exists only where the accepted membership/promotional offer states it. The launch intent is one Book after one completed qualifying year for the Founding 50, Early 100 and standard annual members where the standard offer continues to include it.

§4. One Book per Couple Space

Unless expressly stated otherwise, one included Book = one physical Book per eligible Couple Space, not one per partner. Additional copies/upgrades may be separately priced.

§5. Eligibility and no hidden engagement threshold

Eligibility is generally the qualifying membership start/activation date + one completed year. No undisclosed streak, 365-Memory, daily login, Letter count or relationship score is required. Ordinary inactivity does not cancel an otherwise valid entitlement.

§6. Book Builder

Eligibility begins the creation workflow; it does not automatically print private content. Pairlum may gather eligible Memories, suggest groupings/layouts, detect duplicates/quality issues and help curate the year. Suggestions remain subject to Couple review.

§7. AI assistance

Optional software/AI assistance may help organize, deduplicate, suggest layout or curate content, but must not invent fictional relationship events and present them as real. Any processing of private content remains subject to D1.

§8. Page, cover and personalization limits

The standard included Book has the applicable page limit; additional pages/larger formats/premium covers can be paid upgrades if offered. Cover choices should be a curated set. Users must review names, dates, captions, crops and personalization before approval.

§9. Rights to print

Users must have the rights/permission necessary to reproduce selected content, including professional photography or third-party copyrighted material. Approval grants Pairlum and authorized providers only the limited right needed to prepare, print, bind, package and deliver the approved Book.

§10. Printers and data minimization

Pairlum may use third-party print/fulfilment providers. They receive only the approved production files and limited fulfilment information necessary for their role. They do not receive unrestricted access to the Couple’s Pairlum archive.

§11. Image quality

Pairlum aims to use the highest suitable source available, ideally the preserved original. It may classify images as high quality / usable / low resolution and prompt the Couple to find an original, replace the image or print it smaller. Pairlum cannot create genuine detail that is absent from a compressed source.

§12. Colour and crop expectations

Reasonable differences can occur between backlit screens and print. Minor normal tolerances are not automatically defects. The proof should show crop/safe-area/gutter information where useful so important faces/text are not accidentally trimmed.

§13. Digital proof and final approval

Before normal personalized production, Pairlum provides a digital proof or equivalent final preview of cover/spine/pages/layout. Final production requires the configured approval workflow, which may require both partners or a clearly designated approver. Pairlum records proof version and approval timestamp.

§14. Changes and cancellation

Before final approval/production, users can ordinarily revise within the Book Builder. Once final proof is approved and custom manufacturing begins, ordinary change-of-mind cancellation/changes may no longer be possible.

Customization never removes remedies for defects, damage, the wrong Book, material production errors, or other non-conforming goods protected by applicable law.

§15. User-approved vs production errors

A mistake clearly shown and approved in the final proof—such as user-entered spelling, date, chosen photo/crop or cover—does not normally require a free reprint. A material mismatch caused by Pairlum or its provider should be remedied without making the Couple pay for the provider’s production error.

§16. Shipping territory and address

Standard included V1 fulfilment is intended for India. International service may be unavailable or separately charged. Pairlum collects the shipping address when fulfilment is needed and may be unable to redirect an order after the production/courier lock point.

§17. Delivery, loss and damage

Delivery dates are estimates unless expressly guaranteed. For verified lost-in-transit or materially damaged Books, Pairlum should arrange an appropriate replacement/reprint/refund remedy. Customers may be asked for reasonable photographs of damage/packaging, but Pairlum should minimize unnecessary exposure of intimate content.

§18. Manufacturing defects

  • Missing/wrong-order pages, severe print failure, binding failure, wrong cover or wrong personalization caused by Pairlum/vendor.
  • Another Couple’s Book, wrong-customer content, or material departure from approved proof.
  • Appropriate remedies may include correction, reprint, replacement, partial refund or full refund as required.

§19. Wrong Couple’s Book

If a customer receives another Couple’s Book, they must not publish/copy/share it and should immediately contact privacy/book support. Pairlum treats this as a serious privacy incident and may arrange secure return/destruction and replacement.

§20. Additional copies/upgrades

Extra copies, larger formats, additional pages, alternative covers, premium packaging or expedited production may be separately priced. Declining an upgrade must not prevent a valid eligible Couple from receiving the standard included Book.

§21. No automatic cash substitute/value guarantee

An included Book entitlement does not automatically convert into cash. Marketing value estimates do not create a cash entitlement; the contractual benefit is the applicable Book specification.

§22. Entitlement expiry and deletion

Pairlum should not impose a hidden short claim deadline. Any future claim period must be reasonable, disclosed and reminded. Permanent Couple Space deletion before eligibility normally ends an unearned benefit. If the Book is already earned, Pairlum should clearly explain options before deletion rather than silently destroy the entitlement.

§23. Separation

If a Couple separates, Book production may require additional authorization/review because the draft can contain contributions from both people. Pairlum should protect privacy/content rights and avoid disclosing one former partner’s private content without a proper basis.

§24. Production-file retention and privacy

Approved production files may be retained only as long as reasonably necessary for printing, quality, reprints, support/disputes and legal obligations. Printer/vendor confidentiality/security should be treated as part of vendor selection, not just print quality/cost.

§25. Vendor failure and equivalent fulfilment

If the original printer/material becomes unavailable, Pairlum should seek an equivalent or better provider/specification or another appropriate remedy. An earned Book benefit should not vanish merely because one vendor closes.

D6 · Public policy

Cookie & Tracking Notice

Draft, not yet in effect. This policy is awaiting review by qualified Indian counsel. Bracketed items such as [LEGAL NAME / ENTITY] are intentional until they are formally confirmed.

PUBLICATION DRAFT | Last updated: 26 August 2026 | Target effective date: 4 September 2026

Operator: [LEGAL NAME / ENTITY OPERATING PAIRLUM], [LEGAL / BUSINESS ADDRESS], India. Replace all contact placeholders and planned domain emails before publication.

§1. Technologies covered

This notice covers cookies, local/session storage, authentication tokens, pixels, analytics identifiers and similar technologies.

§2. Pairlum tracking principle

Pairlum tracks what is reasonably necessary to operate, secure and improve the service—not the substance of a private relationship.

§3. Essential technologies

Essential technologies may operate automatically for authentication, sessions, security, fraud prevention, preference/consent storage, checkout and core functionality. Blocking them may break Pairlum.

§4. Analytics

Pairlum plans privacy-conscious product/web analytics (currently PostHog is the preferred tool). Events may include account/onboarding/partner invite/join, feature usage, payment funnel, technical errors, performance, referrer/campaign and timestamps.

Analytics should not intentionally receive the private photograph, private URL, Letter/Note body, Time Capsule content, voice transcript or intimate relationship details merely for analytics.

§5. Authenticated private spaces

Pairlum applies a stricter standard inside Home, Memories, Letters, Chapters, Time Capsules, Parallel Moments and Book Builder. Session replay is OFF for V1 in authenticated private spaces.

§6. Public pages and free tools

Public marketing/SEO/tool pages may use privacy-minimized analytics to understand acquisition and tool usage. Free-tool input should not be unnecessarily copied into analytics.

§7. Marketing technologies

Meta Pixel, Google advertising technologies or similar tools are not essential. They should only be enabled when Pairlum actually needs them and when the chosen consent/legal configuration supports it.

§8. Consent interface

Where Pairlum provides consent choices: Essential — always active; Analytics — optional where applicable; Marketing — optional. A banner should provide visible Accept All / Reject Optional / Manage Preferences choices without deceptive dark patterns.

§9. Referral attribution

Pairlum may process UTM/referral parameters to understand creator/Google/Instagram campaigns and measure visit → signup → activated Couple → paid Couple. Referral identifiers must not contain intimate relationship data.

§10. Payment/security providers

Payment and other security providers may use their own essential fraud/session technologies. Their direct interfaces may be governed by their policies as well as Pairlum’s.

§11. Browser controls and privacy signals

Users may delete/block cookies using their browser, though essential features can stop working. Pairlum should honour Global Privacy Control or other legally required privacy signals where applicable. Do Not Track is handled according to applicable standards/law as they evolve.

§12. Cookie inventory

Before publication maintain an actual inventory showing technology/provider/purpose/category/duration. Do not publish invented cookie names or durations. Include authentication/session, consent preference, PostHog configuration, payment/session and any marketing pixel actually deployed.

§13. Permanent tracking prohibitions

No private-content advertising profiles; no sale of intimate relationship tracking data; no deliberate use of private Letters/photos/voice to infer vulnerability/relationship quality for ads; no session replay in private V1 Couple Spaces.

D7 · Public policy

Acceptable Use Policy

Draft, not yet in effect. This policy is awaiting review by qualified Indian counsel. Bracketed items such as [LEGAL NAME / ENTITY] are intentional until they are formally confirmed.

PUBLICATION DRAFT | Last updated: 26 August 2026 | Target effective date: 4 September 2026

Operator: [LEGAL NAME / ENTITY OPERATING PAIRLUM], [LEGAL / BUSINESS ADDRESS], India. Replace all contact placeholders and planned domain emails before publication.

§1. General rule and age

Pairlum V1 is for users aged 18+. Pairlum may not be used for unlawful, abusive, exploitative, fraudulent or malicious activity or to violate another person’s rights/privacy/security.

§2. User responsibility and rights to content

Users are responsible for content they intentionally create/upload/transmit and should only use material they own or have the necessary consent/licence/lawful right to use.

§3. Non-consensual intimate content

Pairlum prohibits unlawful non-consensual intimate imagery/recordings, including secretly recorded material, revenge pornography, stolen intimate media, coercively obtained content, threats to distribute it and non-consensual manipulated/synthetic intimate imagery.

§4. Child sexual exploitation

Pairlum strictly prohibits child sexual exploitation/abuse material in photographic, video, illustrated, AI-generated, manipulated or other form and may take immediate action/report/preserve evidence as legally required.

§5. Exploitation, coercion and harassment

Users may not blackmail, threaten, coerce, stalk, harass, intimidate, exploit or use private material as leverage against a partner/former partner.

§6. Surveillance and impersonation

Users may not secretly access a partner’s account, install monitoring software, obtain credentials through deception, track someone without appropriate permission, bypass privacy controls or impersonate another person.

§7. Unauthorized Couple Space access

Guessing IDs, manipulating APIs/Couple IDs, reusing signed links, bypassing RLS/authorization or otherwise accessing another Couple’s Memory/Book/Letter is prohibited. Discovering a vulnerability does not authorize browsing private data.

§8. Vulnerability reporting

Legitimate security issues should be reported to [SECURITY EMAIL] without unnecessary exploitation, download/destruction of user data or extortion. A separate vulnerability disclosure policy may be added later.

§9. Malware and harmful code

Viruses, worms, ransomware, spyware, credential stealers, malicious scripts or other harmful code are prohibited. Pairlum may technically inspect/quarantine uploaded files for security.

§10. Fraud and promotional abuse

Fraudulent payments, stolen payment methods, fake refund/chargeback abuse, duplicate/fake Founding claims, resale of non-transferable entitlements, automated registrations, manipulation of cohort counters or membership states are prohibited.

§11. Intellectual property and privacy violations

Users may not knowingly infringe copyright/trademark or upload stolen/leaked/private data without lawful authority. Professional photos may remain subject to photographer copyright even if they depict the users.

§12. Scraping, bots, spam and infrastructure abuse

Unauthorized scraping of private Couple data, automated fake-account creation, invitation spam, analytics/referral manipulation, abusive Free Tool automation, or using Pairlum primarily as generic cloud/CDN infrastructure is prohibited. Pairlum may apply reasonable fair-use controls.

§13. Phishing and credential theft

Users may not collect passwords/OTP/UPI PIN/CVV, create fake Pairlum login pages or distribute phishing links. Pairlum support must never request those secrets.

§14. Payment-system abuse

Forging payment-success events, altering payment references, exploiting webhooks, accessing another Couple’s transactions or manipulating cohort logic is prohibited.

§15. Reports and urgent cases

Reports can be sent to [SUPPORT EMAIL], with privacy/NCII to [PRIVACY EMAIL], IP/legal to [LEGAL EMAIL], security to [SECURITY EMAIL]. Pairlum should request only the evidence reasonably needed, especially for intimate-content complaints.

Child exploitation, NCII, active cross-Couple exposure, account compromise and serious threats are urgent/P0 escalations.

§16. Enforcement

Pairlum may review relevant metadata/logs/content only as necessary, preserve evidence, restrict/disable content, suspend/terminate accounts, revoke fraudulent entitlements and comply with valid law. Enforcement should be proportionate and distinguish good-faith mistakes from deliberate abuse.

§17. Appeals and no retaliation

Where appropriate, users can challenge mistaken enforcement through support/grievance channels. Legitimate privacy complaints, refund requests, security reports or criticism are not grounds for retaliation.

D8 · Public policy

Data Export, Account & Deletion Policy

Draft, not yet in effect. This policy is awaiting review by qualified Indian counsel. Bracketed items such as [LEGAL NAME / ENTITY] are intentional until they are formally confirmed.

PUBLICATION DRAFT | Last updated: 26 August 2026 | Target effective date: 4 September 2026

Operator: [LEGAL NAME / ENTITY OPERATING PAIRLUM], [LEGAL / BUSINESS ADDRESS], India. Replace all contact placeholders and planned domain emails before publication.

§1. Core distinction

Pairlum distinguishes individual account from shared Couple Space. One partner leaving/deleting their account must not automatically and silently destroy everything belonging to the other partner, while the shared structure must not create an unlimited partner veto over valid privacy rights.

§2. Four separate actions

  • Delete an item — e.g., one Memory.
  • Leave Couple Space — disconnect relationship access while potentially retaining the individual account.
  • Delete My Account — delete the individual account/eligible personal data.
  • Delete Our Couple Space — permanently close the shared archive. Each action has different consequences.

§3. Access and correction

Users may request information concerning personal data Pairlum processes and may correct inaccurate/incomplete information through self-service controls or privacy support, subject to applicable law and identity verification.

§4. Export My Data / Export Our Pairlum

Pairlum intends to provide useful product export functionality. An export may include eligible Photos, Videos, Voice, Memories, Notes, Letters, Chapters, Time Capsules and metadata, ideally using preserved originals where available.

Export is not a mechanism to reveal another partner’s private draft/locked content or to override rights/access controls. Pairlum may structure/redact exports to protect both users.

§5. Export security

Exports may require reauthentication, one-time/expiring links, secure delivery or encryption. Pairlum should not email an entire intimate archive as an unprotected attachment.

§6. Delete one Memory

Eligible deleted content normally moves to Recently Deleted for 30 days before active-system permanent deletion. Authorized users may restore during the recovery period. “Delete Permanently” requires stronger confirmation.

§7. Backups and lawful retention

Permanent deletion begins removal from active systems, but information may remain temporarily in protected backups and limited security/payment/legal records until the relevant lifecycle/obligation ends. Pairlum must not promise instant deletion from every backup or retain full private archives indefinitely “just in case.”

§8. Delete My Account

Before account deletion Pairlum should explain the effect on the Couple Space, user-created/shared content, export, Founding status, Book eligibility and records that must remain. Reauthentication is required. Partner B’s account and Partner B-created content are not automatically erased by Partner A’s deletion.

§9. Shared content

Parallel Moments, shared Chapters, collaborative Capsules, paired Memories and Book projects may contain contributions from both users. Pairlum may need to remove one contribution, preserve another, disable/split the object or manually review. Do not implement the simplistic rule “uploader controls everything” or “partner keeps everything.”

§10. Leave Couple Space

Leaving is separate from account deletion. It can stop future relationship access/activity while preserving the individual account and enabling applicable export/deletion workflows. Pairlum does not require a breakup explanation or use guilt/streak mechanics.

§11. Partner notification

Where appropriate and safe, Pairlum may notify the connected partner that the Pairlum connection ended without disclosing unnecessary reasons. Safety/security investigations may justify delaying or limiting notice.

§12. Delete Our Couple Space

Entire Couple Space deletion is a higher-risk action. For an ordinary active Couple Space with both-partner contributions, the preferred V1 product rule is both-partner confirmation, where legally/operationally appropriate, plus strong warning, export-first option and reauthentication.

Two-partner confirmation is not absolute; abuse, death/incapacity, legal orders, abandoned/compromised accounts, unlawful content or individual statutory rights may require another reviewed process.

§13. Couple Space deletion grace period

Pairlum should initially use a 30-day Scheduled for Deletion period for ordinary full-space deletion, unless applicable law/safety/unlawful content requires another timeline. Where allowed, pending deletion may be cancelled before final destruction.

§14. Book and deletion

Permanent deletion before an unearned Book eligibility date normally ends the future benefit, and Pairlum must warn before deletion. If the Book has already been earned, Pairlum should clearly present options (complete Book, export, waive, other lawful route) rather than silently delete the earned entitlement. Approved Books already in production may require limited fulfilment retention.

§15. Membership/refund are separate

Cancelling membership, receiving a refund, Founding withdrawal or account suspension are not themselves deletion requests. Data actions follow this policy.

§16. Death/incapacity and nomination

Pairlum may develop a verified process for a duly nominated/authorized person to exercise applicable rights after death/incapacity. Pairlum must not release an archive simply because someone claims to have been the partner.

§17. Identity verification

Rights/export/deletion requests may require authenticated-account verification, password re-entry, email confirmation, MFA or another proportionate step. Pairlum should not routinely demand excessive government documents if safer account verification is sufficient.

§18. Admin request workflow

Admin states should include RECEIVED, IDENTITY_CHECK, IN_REVIEW, WAITING_FOR_USER, APPROVED, PROCESSING, COMPLETED and DECLINED. Log request ID, type, account/Couple, dates, verification, decision, administrator and reason without putting private content into the audit log.

§19. Service providers and analytics

When eligible personal data is permanently deleted and no lawful retention purpose remains, Pairlum should cause relevant processors to delete according to contracts/technical processes. Analytics-linked data is handled where applicable, while private content should not have been sent to analytics in the first place.

§20. Post-membership storage

Pairlum must define the exact post-expiry storage/access policy before paid memberships begin. Do not promise indefinite free cloud hosting, but do not implement sudden deletion merely because a membership expires. Provide clear notice and reasonable export/account-management options.

§21. No data hostage / external copies

Pairlum should not use “pay forever or your relationship disappears immediately” as a retention model. Deleting Pairlum’s copy also cannot delete independent copies another person already has outside Pairlum.

§22. Export before deletion and no dark patterns

Before destructive account/Couple actions, prominently offer Export First where appropriate, explain the consequences, reauthenticate and confirm. Do not hide deletion, require sales calls, guilt users or force a public breakup reason.
